item.title: github: Improved detection for withdrawn Dependabot alerts
item.description:
GitHub improved how withdrawn Dependabot alerts are identified. When an advisory or vulnerability is no longer valid, Dependabot now withdraws and removes the alert, and these changes make that state easier to detect.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Anonymous organization-level registries for Dependabot
item.description:
GitHub Dependabot now supports an Anonymous authentication method for organization-level private registries. This is intended for registries reachable without credentials, such as an internal package mirror.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Repository custom runner settings for Dependabot
item.description:
Repository administrators can now set the runner type, optional custom label, and optional runner group for Dependabot version and security updates. This extends existing runner configuration options for Dependabot.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Customize Dependabot pull request branch names
item.description:
Dependabot now supports custom pull request branch names through new pull-request-branch-name settings in .github/dependabot.yml. You can configure a prefix, maximum length, and separators for segments and words.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Dependabot alerts on malicious packages across more ecosystems
item.description:
GitHub Advisory Database now ingests malware advisories from OpenSSF’s malicious-packages repository, expanding the malware data available to Dependabot alerts. This broadens coverage across more ecosystems.

  • Source: GitHub
